card.name: Words missing an article in headlines
card.fires_on: Small words and nouns in news headlines or list-style web text where an article like 'a' or 'the' has been dropped, such as 'wins it with single in 9th'.

modes.label: Headline with dropped article
modes.description: A preposition or noun in a clipped news headline where 'a' or 'the' is left out.
modes.example: Dom Brown wins it<< with>> single in 9th (11

modes.label: Other link words in web text
modes.description: A linking word such as 'to' or 'you' before a verb or noun in casual web prose.
modes.example: Your eye may be teary or gunky, especially when<< you>> wake up in the morning.

card.plain: It fires on short link words in clipped headlines, where the article has been left out.
